subject: general
question: Brihadeshwara temple at Thanjavur is one of the largest temples in India and is an example of Dravidian architecture during the ______ period.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chola**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Brihadeshwara Temple of Thanjavur

 
 
• It was built by Raja Raja Chola I__.
 
• __Brihadeshwara Temple, Thanjavur is in Tamil Nadu__. It is a Hindu Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• It is one of the largest temples in the southern part of India.
 
• It is built between 1003 and 1010 AD by Raja Raja Chola I in Dravidian architecture style.
 
• It is on the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
 
• It is also called Dakshina Meru which simplifies “Meru of South”.
 
 

__
 
• Chola (848-871 AD):

 
 
• Vijayalaya was the founder of the Chola Empire.
 
• He ruled over the region to the north of the river Kaveri.
 
• He built a temple of Goddess Nishumbhasudini (Durga).
 
• He also undertook the renovation of the city of Thanjavur.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Cheras

 
 
• The Cheras ruled over the Malabar coast and were also known as Keralaputra.
 
• The Chera kingdom of Mahodayapuram was established in the 9th century in present-day Kerala.
 
• The rulers and the people of the Chera kingdom used the Malayalam language.
 
• The scripts and inscriptions were written in the Malayalam language.
 
• The Chera kingdom was one of the earliest kingdoms to use regional language in their court.
 
 

 
• Hoysala Empire

 
 
• The Hoysala Empire was a prominent south Indian empire from the 10th to 14th centuries and ruled mostly modern-day Karnataka. 
 
• The Hoysala Dynasty was the prominent dynasty of the Kannadiga region (what is now Karnataka, India).
 
• The capital of the Hoysalays was Belur (later moved to Halebidu).
 
• Nripa Kama II(1026–1047) was the founder of the Hoysala Dynasty.
 
• Veera Ballala III(1292–1343) was the last ruler of Hoysala Dynasty.
 
 
 
• **​****The Pandya** 
 
 
• The Pandya kingdom was a Tamil kingdom in south India.
 
• Madurai __was the capital of the__ Pandyan dynasty__ until the middle of the 14th century and __Korkai __was also the__ capital and port city of Pandya.__
 
• The third capital was Tenkasi until the end of the 16th century.
 
• The Pandyas revived under Kadungon (590 – 620 CE) towards the end of the 6th century, helped to disestablish the Kalabhras in south India.
